text:
Sam (People Ops): quick Q thread for managers prepping off-cycle promos. using this to capture answers so we don't repeat in DMs.
Carmen (Eng Manager): if an off-cycle promo is approved but the IC wants the title change only (no comp), do we still run the full comp-change workflow?
Noor (People Ops Partner): yes please run the workflow so records match and title bits propagate to managers/org chart. mark the comp field as 'no change' in the form.
Carmen (Eng Manager): cool. second: candidate was promoted externally before we finalized comp. can we match external offer retroactively?
Diego (Payroll): retro-matching external offers is rare. if you need to match, escalate to @Noor + Finance. payroll needs signed approval + comp-change by cutoff to do retro pay.
Hannah (Hiring Ops): related: for internal slotting, if you want to convert a promoted IC's open role to contractor temp, submit a `slot-change` request and tag hiring-ops. it goes to the same routing but we annotate hiring priority.
Carmen (Eng Manager): evidence note: someone has 2 repos of work, which should be attached?
Sam (People Ops): attach the most representative 2 artifacts (PRs, tech designs, postmortems). large demos OK as links. see playbook: https://intranet.redwood.com/leveling/playbook
Noor (People Ops Partner): calibration tip: managers should include impact quantifiers (latency reduced X, cost saved Y, customer retention metric). metrics help panels a lot.
Carmen (Eng Manager): appeals: after panel, if manager disagrees with final outcome what is the path?
Noor (People Ops Partner): there is an escalation ladder: 1) request written feedback from panel, 2) file an exception with new evidence within 7 days for off-cycle, 14 for regular cycle, 3) final review by Head of Eng + People Ops. outcomes are final for that cycle.
Diego (Payroll): payroll cutoffs: 2025-07-01 17:00 PT for July payroll. if comp changes miss cutoff we'll process retro in next payroll run. notify payroll if expecting a late decision.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: "Off-cycle promo packet due" on 2025-06-28 09:00 PT.
Sam (People Ops): i'll post a 1-page checklist and an exception template to #people-ops-resources. ping @Noor for any special approvals. :white_check_mark:
